latest_release.name: Release v2.5.22
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* chore: begin 2.5.22-SNAPSHOT by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/917
* fix(cli): refuse --to-stdout with a format that stdout cannot carry by @bundolee in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/918
* fix(core): read the columns first when a gap starts a section in one column only by @bundolee in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/921
* fix(core): do not read an underline below a text as a leader by @bundolee in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/922
* chore(agents): keep only the maintenance rules and tools of this repository by @bundolee in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/923
* fix(node): preserve Java CLI exit codes by @dacheng-lu in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/924
* fix(node): print only Error messages on a CLI failure by @bundolee in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/925
* fix(core): put the root Document of a PDF 2.0 tagged PDF in the PDF 2.0 namespace by @bundolee in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/927

## New Contributors
* @dacheng-lu made their first contribution in https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/pull/924

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/opendataloader-project/opendataloader-pdf/compare/v2.5.21...v2.5.22
